newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme to buy PharmaGenics for stock. [CORRECTED 23:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Genzyme to buy PharmaGenics for stock. [CORRECTED 23:22 GMT]

text.p: Genzyme Corp said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire PharmaGenics Inc -- a privately-held company that develops therapeutic products for cancer -- for about four million shares of a new Genzyme tracking stock.
Genzyme said it will not issue any new shares of its current stocks -- Genzyme General Division or Genzyme Tissue Repair -- in connection with the acquisition, which is expected to close in May.
PharmaGenics' programs and technologies will be combined with several oncology projects within Genzyme's General Division to form Genzyme Molecular Oncology, a new division of the corporation.

This new unit will develop and commercialize molecular approaches to cancer diagnosis and therapy by integrating four technologies, genomics, gene therapy, genetic diagnostics, and a small-molecule combinatorial chemistry drug discovery program.
Genzyme will create a third stock for Genzyme Molecular Oncology, which will track the performance of the new division, the company said.

A Genzyme official said Genzyme will create 10 million tracking shares of Genzyme Molecular, four million of which will be given to PharmaGenics shareholders and the other six million to shareholders of Genzyme General Division.

The official said Genzyme planned to make an initial public offering later this year of Genzyme Molecular. She did not say how many shares would be offered in the IPO. The offering depends on market conditions, she said. (Corrects from "A Genzyme official said Genzyme will sell ten million shares." to "She did not say how many shares would be offered in the IPO.")
